cohort: The study participants were pregnant women categorized into groups: healthy controls, only obesity, gestational DM with obesity, pregestational DM with obesity, and gestational hypertension with obesity.
finding: Obesity and its comorbidities (DM and GHT) were associated with specific and meaningful changes in serum levels of BMP-4, BMP-2, GDF-15, MMP-9, and GP39 in pregnant women.
